title: Personal Credit Cards: application eligibility and underwriting decisions
content:
# Personal Credit Cards: application eligibility and underwriting

This policy covers new applications on the Personal Credit Cards line: what an application records, which applicant checks apply to the requested tier, who decides approval, and what an approved account carries. The per-tier figures it refers to (age limits, security deposit, credit limit range, purchase APR range and cash advance APR) are the tier's own terms.

## Policy clauses

1. An application records the requested tier and is held in applied status while it awaits underwriting. On approval the account becomes active; an application that underwriting declines, or that the applicant withdraws, is closed.
2. The applicant's age in whole years on the application date, taken from the date of birth on the customer profile, must be at least the tier's youngest age and, where the tier sets one, no more than its oldest age. The applicant's age must meet the tier's age limits on the application date.
3. Visa Infinite Private Client requires an active Private Client Checking account held by the applicant.
4. Secured Visa requires a security deposit of at least the tier's smallest deposit, and its credit limit always equals the deposit held.
5. Approval and decline are underwriting decisions made by the credit system; the agent never decides them.
6. An approved limit lies between the tier's smallest and largest credit limit, and the purchase APR between the tier's lowest and highest purchase APR; the cash advance APR is the tier's.
7. On tiers offering an introductory balance transfer APR, the introductory period ends on the statement closing date in the cycle after opening whose number equals the tier's introductory period in months.

## Checks and their evidence

| Check | Evidence | Authority |
|---|---|---|
| Age limits | date of birth on the customer profile, compared on the application date | the bank's customer record |
| Private Client requirement (Visa Infinite Private Client only) | an active Private Client Checking account held by the applicant | the bank's checking account records |
| Secured deposit (Secured Visa only) | the deposit held | the application record |

## Worked illustration of the age count (hypothetical dates)

An applicant born on 15 August 2005 is 20 in whole years on an application dated 14 August 2026, and 21 on an application dated 15 August 2026. The whole-year figure on the application date is the one compared with the tier's age limits.

## Basis Q&A

**Q: Can the agent approve an application or set its limit?**
A: No. Approval and decline are made by the credit system; the agent never decides them.

**Q: What limit does an approved Secured Visa carry?**
A: A limit equal to the security deposit held.

**Q: Does a customer's statement of their age replace the profile?**
A: No. The age is taken from the date of birth on the customer profile.
